💃🇦🇷 Tango Evening – Rotary Friendship & Fellowship

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
RFE Argentina 2026–27 | District 4895

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange to Argentina, the 10 Rotarians from Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, enjoyed a memorable evening of International fellowship and Argentine culture with District Governor Gustavo J. Tondi along with her wife and fellow international Rotarians of District 4895.

The evening brought together Rotarians from different countries in the true spirit of Rotary friendship and global fellowship. Over a wonderful dinner, members shared experiences, strengthened connections and celebrated the bonds created through the RFE programme.

The highlight of the evening was an enchanting presentation of traditional Argentine Tango, offering the visiting Rotarians a wonderful glimpse into Argentina’s rich cultural heritage.

It was an evening filled with friendship, laughter, culture and unforgettable memories—a beautiful example of how Rotary brings people and cultures together.

Different Countries • One Rotary Family • Friendships for a Lifetime ❤️
